name: Technical
summary: Ball mastery, passing, receiving, dribbling, finishing.
detail: Every session begins and ends with the ball. Players build a technical foundation precise enough to execute under pressure, not just in isolation drills.

name: Tactical
summary: Game understanding, decision-making, positioning and team principles.
detail: Players are coached to read the game, not just play it — understanding space, timing and team structure the way Argentine academies have taught for generations.

name: Physical
summary: Speed, agility, coordination, strength and conditioning.
detail: Age-appropriate athletic development builds durable, explosive players without compromising long-term physical health.

name: Psychological
detail: Football is decided under pressure. Players are trained to make split-second decisions with composure, on the biggest occasions.

name: Social
detail: A player's development off the pitch shapes their game on it. We build character alongside craft.

name: Performance
summary: Data, analysis, feedback and individual development planning.
detail: Every player's progress is tracked, reviewed and translated into an individual development plan — evidence, not guesswork.
